Recent Translations at Your Disposal: Never lose track of your past work. The second tab neatly organizes your recently translated texts, offering quick access and revisitation. Utilize our text-to-speech functionality to hear translations aloud, enhancing pronunciation skills (note: some language exceptions apply). Your translations are securely saved locally, ensuring privacy and offline access.

Phrase Book for Quick Reference: The third tab is your gateway to a wealth of pre-translated phrases, ideal for travelers and learners. This curated phrase book, sourced from a comprehensive JSON file, is an invaluable resource for common expressions. Initially locked, this premium feature can be unlocked through a simple in-app purchase, expanding your linguistic arsenal.
